title: seismic-vibration-tmd-sim: Numerical Simulation of Structural Dynamics and Tuned Mass Dampers Under Seismic Excitation
description: Scientific engineering simulator for structural dynamics in single and multi-degree-of-freedom (SDOF / 2DOF) systems equipped with Tuned Mass Dampers (TMD). Computes dynamic amplification, resonance suppression, and transient time-history responses under seismic acceleration records.
